possible_causes: Unintended copper bridging between adjacent conductors
potential_impact: Unintended electrical connection between circuit nets
Possible excessive current, malfunction, or component damage
corrective_action: Inspect the suspected bridge against the PCB layout
Verify isolation between affected conductors
Assess approved rework or board rejection

possible_causes: Incomplete removal of unwanted copper during etching
potential_impact: Possible short circuit if the protrusion contacts another conductor
corrective_action: Inspect the protrusion and adjacent conductor clearance
Compare the feature against the approved PCB layout
Assess approved copper-removal rework if necessary

possible_causes: Unwanted copper retained during pattern transfer
potential_impact: Reduced electrical clearance or short-circuit risk
corrective_action: Compare the copper feature against the PCB layout
Check its proximity and electrical relationship to nearby conductors
Assess approved removal or board rejection

possible_causes: Excessive etching or incomplete conductor formation
Mechanical damage interrupting a copper trace
potential_impact: Possible malfunction of the connected circuit
corrective_action: Inspect the affected trace against the PCB layout
Verify continuity using an appropriate electrical test
Assess approved conductor repair or board rejection

possible_causes: Localized over-etching along a conductor edge
potential_impact: Reduced conductor width at the affected region
Possible increased resistance or reduced current-carrying margin
corrective_action: Inspect the conductor-edge indentation
Compare remaining conductor width with design requirements
Assess acceptance or approved rework using applicable criteria

possible_causes: Drill misregistration relative to the copper pad
Insufficient annular ring or manufacturing alignment variation
corrective_action: Inspect hole-to-pad alignment and remaining annular ring
Compare the condition with applicable fabrication acceptance criteria
Assess electrical testing, approved rework, or rejection

possible_causes: Mechanical abrasion during handling or fabrication
potential_impact: Potential loss of continuity or long-term reliability
corrective_action: Inspect scratch depth and affected conductor width
Verify continuity where appropriate
Assess acceptance or approved repair against applicable criteria

possible_causes: Residual processing material deposited on a conductor
potential_impact: Possible electrical bridging if the object is conductive
Potential interference with coating, soldering, or reliability
corrective_action: Inspect and identify the foreign material
Assess whether it affects adjacent conductors or processing
Use an approved cleaning or disposition procedure

possible_causes: Foreign particle inclusion during laminate processing
Contamination during PCB manufacturing or handling
potential_impact: Potential localized manufacturing or assembly issues
corrective_action: Inspect the foreign object and surrounding base material
Assess its location, size, and material characteristics
Determine acceptance or rejection using applicable criteria
